contentEn:
Planning a bathroom renovation in Vancouver in 2026? Reno Stars has completed over 50 bathroom remodels across Metro Vancouver. Here is what real projects actually cost this year.

Average Bathroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver, 2026

Bathroom renovation costs in Vancouver ranged from $18,500 to $72,000 in 2025, based on actual Reno Stars project invoices. The wide range reflects three distinct scopes:

  • Small / powder room (under 40 sq ft): $18,500 – $28,000
  • Standard main bathroom (40–80 sq ft): $28,000 – $48,000
  • Large / master bath (80+ sq ft or full gut): $48,000 – $72,000

These figures cover all trades, materials, labour, permits, and HST. They do not include cosmetic upgrades like freestanding tubs ($3,000–$8,000 extra) or heated floors ($1,200–$3,500 extra).

What Drives the Cost of a Bathroom Remodel in Vancouver

Four factors determine where your project lands in that range:

  • Scope of work — A bathtub-to-shower swap runs $18,500–$25,000. A full gut including new plumbing rerouting, curbless shower, double vanity, and heated floors reaches $55,000–$72,000.
  • Age of building — Pre-1980 Vancouver Specials and character homes often require pipe replacement, adding $4,000–$12,000 to plumbing costs. Strata approval in condos adds $500–$2,500 in fees and potential design restrictions.
  • Material selections — A porcelain tile shower with a composite countertop and off-the-shelf fixtures keeps costs down. Natural stone tiles, frameless glass, custom millwork, and designer fixtures push totals toward the high end.
  • Permit requirements — In Vancouver, a plumbing permit costs $200–$500; an electrical permit adds $150–$300. Most full bathroom gut renovations require both. Heritage designation or changes to load-bearing walls trigger additional City of Vancouver review.

Timeline: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take?

A small powder room refresh takes 3–5 weeks. A standard full bathroom remodel typically runs 7–10 weeks from demolition to handover. A large master bath with structural or plumbing changes requires 10–16 weeks, including City of Vancouver permit processing time of 4–6 weeks for complex applications.

Delays in material sourcing — particularly custom glass, imported tiles, and special-order vanities — are the most common cause of timeline overruns in Vancouver bathroom projects. Ordering long-lead items early is standard practice for Reno Stars projects.

Real Project Examples from Reno Stars

Three recent Vancouver bathroom renovations illustrate the cost range:

  • Kitsilano ensuite — $44,500: 85 sq ft; new curbless shower with frameless glass, double floating vanity, heated tile floor, full repipe, Vancouver permit. 11 weeks.
  • Mount Pleasant powder room — $21,000: 38 sq ft; tub-to-shower conversion, new vanity and toilet, refreshed tile floor, electrical permit. 5 weeks.
  • Yaletown master bath — $68,000: 120 sq ft; full gut, two curbless showers, freestanding soaking tub, custom millwork, all new plumbing, heritage review. 15 weeks.

You can view the full details and photos for each of these projects at /en/projects/two-bathroom-renovation-burnaby-2/ and /en/projects/vancouver-whole-house-renovation-bathroom-updates/.

Vancouver-Specific Permit and Regulatory Notes

Vancouver's Building By-law requires a building permit for any bathroom renovation that changes plumbing locations, adds or moves circuits, or involves structural modifications. A Plumbing permit from the City of Vancouver is mandatory when moving drains, water supply lines, or adding new fixtures. Condos in strata buildings require strata approval before any plumbing work — budget an extra 2–4 weeks for the council meeting cycle.

All renovation work performed in Vancouver must comply with the BC Building Code and Vancouver's Noise Control Bylaw, which restricts noisy work to weekdays between 7 AM and 8 PM.

How to Budget for Your Vancouver Bathroom Renovation

Use this three-step framework before signing any contract:

  1. Define the scope — Write down every fixture you want to keep, move, or remove. A full gut gives you the most long-term value; a partial remodel limits disruption but limits redesign options.
  2. Get a detailed quote — Ask for a line-item breakdown that separates demo, plumbing, electrical, tiling, millwork, fixtures, permits, and HST. Vague per-square-foot quotes hide cost overruns.
  3. Add a contingency — Add 15% for newer homes (under 20 years) and 20–25% for character homes or pre-1980 Vancouver Specials where hidden conditions are common.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

Based on 2025 project data from Reno Stars, a standard bathroom renovation in Vancouver costs between $28,000 and $48,000. Small powder rooms start around $18,500, while large master baths with full plumbing changes can reach $68,000–$72,000. These figures include all trades, materials, labour, permits, and HST.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Vancouver?

Yes, in most cases. Moving plumbing fixtures, adding or modifying electrical circuits, or making structural changes all require permits in Vancouver. A plumbing permit from the City of Vancouver is mandatory when relocating drains or water supply lines. Simple fixture swaps — replacing a toilet, vanity, or bathtub in the same location — may only require a plumbing permit. Check with the City of Vancouver's building counter before starting.

How long does a full bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A standard full bathroom renovation in Vancouver takes 7–10 weeks from demolition to handover. Small powder room remodels take 3–5 weeks. Large master baths with permit-required plumbing or structural changes require 10–16 weeks, including the 4–6 week City of Vancouver permit processing time for complex applications.

What is the most common unexpected cost in Vancouver bathroom renovations?

Hidden plumbing issues are the most common surprise in pre-1980 Vancouver homes. Galvanized steel pipes, outdated wiring, and inadequate water pressure regulators are frequently discovered during demolition. A 20–25% contingency budget for character homes and Vancouver Specials accounts for these discoveries. Condo renovations commonly encounter strata-related delays and special assessment fees.

Can I live in my home during a bathroom renovation?

Yes, for most standard bathroom renovations. You will lose access to the bathroom being renovated for the duration of the project — typically 3–16 weeks depending on scope. Reno Stars coordinates schedules to minimize disruption and can arrange temporary toilet facilities for full-gut renovations. Powder room projects allow you to use other bathrooms in the home throughout construction.

計畫在2026年溫哥華進行浴室翻新？Reno Stars已在Metro Vancouver完成超過50個浴室裝修項目。以下是今年實際項目的真實價格。

2026年溫哥華浴室翻新平均費用

根據Reno Stars實際項目發票，2025年溫哥華浴室翻新費用範圍為$18,500至$72,000加幣。廣泛的範圍反映了三種不同規模：

  • 小型 / 化妝間（40平方英尺以下）：$18,500 – $28,000
  • 標準主浴室（40–80平方英尺）：$28,000 – $48,000
  • 大型 / 主臥浴室（80平方英尺以上或全面翻新）：$48,000 – $72,000

這些費用涵蓋所有工程、材料、人工、許可證和HST。它們不包括化妝升級，如獨立式浴缸（額外$3,000-$8,000）或地暖（額外$1,200-$3,500）。

影響溫哥華浴室裝修費用的因素

四個因素決定您的項目在該範圍內的位置：

  • 工程範圍 — 將浴缸更換為淋浴，費用為$18,500-$25,000。全面翻新，包括新的管道重新鋪設、無障礙淋浴間、雙洗手台和地暖，費用高達$55,000-$72,000。
  • 建築物年齡 — 1980年代以前的溫哥華特別住宅和特色住宅通常需要更換管道，管道工程額外增加$4,000-$12,000。公寓的Strata審批額外增加$500-$2,500的費用和潛在的設計限制。
  • 材料選擇 — 瓷磚淋浴間配合成洗漱台和現成夾具，成本較低。天然石材瓷磚、無框玻璃、定制木制品和設計師夾具將總價推向高端。
  • 許可證要求 — 在溫哥華，管道許可證費用為$200-$500；電氣許可證額外增加$150-$300。大多數全面浴室翻新需要兩者。文物指定或承重牆變更會觸發溫哥華市的額外審查。

時間表：溫哥華浴室翻新需要多長時間？

小型化妝間翻新需要3-5週。標準全浴室翻新通常需要7-10週，從拆除到移交。大型主臥浴室涉及結構或管道變更，需要10-16週，包括溫哥華市複雜申請的4-6週許可證處理時間。

材料採購延遲——特別是定制玻璃、進口瓷磚和特殊訂購洗手台——是溫哥華浴室項目中最常見的時間表超支原因。Reno Stars的項目通常提前訂購長期交貨物品。

來自Reno Stars的實際項目案例

三個最近的溫哥華浴室翻新案例說明費用範圍：

  • Kitsilano套間浴室 — $44,500：85平方英尺；無障礙淋浴間配無框玻璃、雙浮動洗手台、地暖瓷磚、全面換管、溫哥華許可證。11週。
  • Mount Pleasant化妝間 — $21,000：38平方英尺；浴缸轉淋浴、新的洗手台和馬桶、翻新瓷磚地板、電氣許可證。5週。
  • Yaletown主臥浴室 — $68,000：120平方英尺；全面翻新、兩個無障礙淋浴間、獨立浸泡浴缸、定制木制品、所有新管道、文物審查。15週。

您可以在以下網址查看每個項目的完整詳情和照片：/en/projects/two-bathroom-renovation-burnaby-2/ 和 /en/projects/vancouver-whole-house-renovation-bathroom-updates/。

溫哥華特有的許可證和監管說明

溫哥華建築條例要求變更管道位置、增加或移動電路或進行結構修改的任何浴室翻新必須獲得建築許可證。在移動排水管、供水管線或添加新固定裝置時，必須從溫哥華市獲得管道許可證。分契式公寓在開始任何管道工程之前需要分契批准——為理事會會議週期額外預算2-4週。

溫哥華進行的所有裝修工程必須遵守卑詩省建築規範和溫哥華噪音控制條例，該條例將噪音工程限制在工作日早上7點至晚上8點之間。

如何為溫哥華浴室翻新編制預算

在簽訂任何合同之前，使用這個三步驟框架：

  1. 定義範圍 — 寫下您想要保留、移動或移除的每個固定裝置。全面翻新為您提供最大的長期價值；部分裝修限制干擾但限制重新設計選項。
  2. 獲取詳細報價 — 索取逐項細目分類，包括拆除、管道、電氣、瓷磚、木制品、固定裝置、許可證和HST。模糊的每平方英尺報價隱藏了成本超支。
  3. 添加應急費用 — 為較新的房屋（20年以下）添加15%，為特色住宅或1980年代以前的溫哥華特別住宅添加20-25%，因為這些地方常見隱藏問題。

常見問題

2026年溫哥華浴室翻新的平均費用是多少？

根據Reno Stars 2025年項目數據，溫哥華標準浴室翻新的費用在$28,000至$48,000之間。小型化妝間起價約$18,500，而帶全面管道變更的大型主臥浴室可達$68,000-$72,000。這些費用包括所有工程、材料、人工、許可證和HST。

溫哥華浴室翻新需要許可證嗎？

在大多數情況下，是的。移動固定裝置、增加或修改電路或進行結構修改都需要許可證。在溫哥華，重新安置排水管或供水管線或添加新固定裝置時，必須從溫哥華市獲得管道許可證。簡單的固定裝置更換——在相同位置更換馬桶、洗手台或浴缸——可能只需要管道許可證。在開始之前向溫哥華市建築櫃檯確認。

溫哥華全面浴室翻新需要多長時間？

溫哥華標準全面浴室翻新從拆除到移交需要7-10週。小型化妝間翻新需要3-5週。大型主臥浴室涉及許可證要求的管道或結構變更，需要10-16週，包括溫哥華市複雜申請的4-6週許可證處理時間。

溫哥華浴室翻新中最常見的意外費用是什麼？

隱藏的管道問題是1980年代以前溫哥華住宅中最常見的驚喜。鍍鋅鋼管、過時的接線和不足的水壓調節器經常在拆除期間被發現。特色住宅和溫哥華特別住宅的20-25%應急預算用於這些發現。公寓翻新通常會遇到分契相關的延誤和特殊評估費用。

裝修期間我可以住在家裡嗎？

是的，對於大多數標準浴室翻新。您將在整個項目期間無法使用正在翻新的浴室——通常為3-16週，具體取決於範圍。Reno Stars協調時間表以減少干擾，並可為全面管道翻新安排臨時廁所設施。化妝間項目允許您在整個施工期間使用家中的其他浴室。
